Demining in forward areas
*301. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the forward
areas our forces are engaged in clearing
mines without the aid of demining sets and
mine boots;
(b) if so, the number of Jawans killed
and injured so far during the demining
process; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
stop manual demining to save human lives
as well as complete the demining process
quickly?
Return and rehabilitation of
Kashmiri migrants

DR. ABRAR AHMED:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any action plan for the
return and rehabilitation of Kashmiri
migrants have been prepared; and
(b) if so, the status of the plan?
Crimes against women

REDDY:
SHRIMATI SHABANA
AZMI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether in the year 2002, there had
been increasing number of crimes against
women;
(b) if so, what were the main reasons
for the same;
(c) what are the efforts being made to
reduce these crimes against women in 2003;
(d) whether any proposals in this regard
have been worked out; and

employees

Will the Minister of PERSONNEL,
PUBLIC GRIEVANCES AND PENSIONS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
employees are eligible for special C.L. when

they participate in National level Sports
meet as technical officials;

obtaining the said leave;

participation in the sports event; and

Assistance to States affected by power
crisis
†*305. SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of State Governments
which have sought assistance from Central
Government to get rid of power crisis;
(b) the details thereof, State-wise; and
(c) the details of the provision made by
the Central Government to rid the States

Schemes for rural electrification

the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the Central Schemes
under which Rural Electrification Programmes

allocation of funds and achievements made
in the electrification of villages during last
three years (scheme-wise);
(c) the number of villages in the State of
Orissa which are yet to be electrified; and
(d) the target date fixed for the
electrification of those villages?

Reactor (CSR)" for power transfer
*307. SHRI B. J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Bharat Heavy Electricals
Limited (BHEL) has developed a unique
device, called "Controlled Shunt Reactor
(CSR)" the first of its kind in the world, for
improving power transfer capability and
reducing transmission losses;
(b) whether it is a major breakthrough
for the country's power transmission
sector and whether this has been
commissioned at Power Grid, Itarsi in
Madhya Pradesh, as reported in the
Hindustan Times dated the 22nd December,
2002; and
(c) the places where it is now proposed
to be installed?

SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that production
of coking coal in the country is decreasing
constantly since last year;
(b) if so, the production during the year
1999-2000;
(c) the assessment with regard to the
production of the said coal during the current
financial year; and
(d) the reasons for decrease in
production constantly?
Priority to drought affected States
under "Haryali" scheme
†*309. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have handed

the Prime Minister worth rupees 1070

two thousand panchayats of the country;
(b) if so, the names of the States
benefited by this new "Haryali" scheme
from amongst two lakh thirty two thousand
panchayats;

Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:

the Minister of MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to put
any limit on mining in Aravali region;

mining; and
(c) if so, by when the said Bill is
proposed to be brought?

pleased to state:

had decided to issue multi-purpose identity
cards to all bonafide citizens above 14 years
of age;
(b) whether Government was to launch
a pilot project for issuance of I-Cards in
seven border States; and
(c) if so, what is the status of this
scheme?
Water to all by 2010

Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Ministry of
Rural Development would involve

implementation of Water to all by 2010

the programme; and

Electrification Corporation in Bihar during
each of the last three years;
(b) the number of villages electrified
during each of the last three years in Bihar;
and
(c) the electrification programme for the
current year in the State?
Separate jails for women
†*315. SHRIMATI CHANDRA
KALA PANDEY:
SHRIMATI SAROJ DUBEY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(a) whether arrangement for separate
jails for women have been made in all the
districts of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, district-

Special forces in States
*316. SHRI RUMANDLA
RAAMACHANDRAYYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether during the Chief Minister's
Conference on Security, the Andhra
Pradesh Chief Minister has suggested and
urged the Centre to set up special forces in
the States to ensure quick response in
tackling situations like hijacking,
kidnappings and attacks on religious places;
(b) if so, whether many of the State
Governments have also agreed to this
proposal;
(c) if so, the number of such States;
(d) whether Government are considering
to set up such forces in all the States; and
(e) if so, by what time a final decision is
likely to be taken in this regard?

under 'Swajaldhara' scheme

Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government has
received complaints from the State
Governments that the five days given to
States for submitting proposals under the
'Swajaldhara' scheme was not sufficient;
(b) if so, whether Government have
extended the time limit in this regard;
(c) whether the work on 'Swajaldhara'
has commenced; and
(d) by when this scheme is likely to be
completed?
Vision-2020 for facilities in Rural
Areas
†*318. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) programmes formulated in Vision-
2020 to provide urban facilities in rural areas
during the coming three years;
(b) the main features of the programme;
and
(c) the details of the cooperation of State
Governments for the success of the
programme?

CHARJEE: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) the targets set for financial and better
performance to be achieved by each State
Electricity Board (SEB) under Accelerated
Power Development Reform Programme
(APDRP);
(b) the circumstances under which SEBs
were forced to avail the services of
consultants with little experiences of
distribution sector;
(c) if so, the details of consultancy
charges being paid and whether it will be a
grant or loan to SEBs from Government;
and

been saved by availing the services of CEA;
if so, whether Government propose to
assign this work to CEA?
Purchase of AJTs and submarines
*320. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI P. PRABHAKAR :
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to purchase Advance Jet Trainers (AJTs.)
and submarines from foreign countries;
(b) whether global tenders were floated
therefor and if so, the details thereof;

the reasons for inordinate delay therefor;
and
(d) by when a final decision is expected
to be taken?
